entry.name: project

attributes.name: amxdtype
attributes.digest: Max for Live Device Type
attributes.description: Sets the type of device that will be created when the project is exported to a Max for Live device.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autolocalize
attributes.digest: Always Localize Project Items
attributes.description: If enabled, files added to a Project will always be copied to the Project's folder before being included in the Project.

attributes.name: autoorganize
attributes.digest: Keep Project Folder Organized
attributes.description: If enabled, files in the Project's folder are automatically sorted into appropriate subfolders based on the file's category (e.g. "Patchers", "Code", "Media", etc.).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: browsertext
attributes.digest: Annotation
attributes.description: Sets the annotation name for the project. If set, the project can be searched for in the File Browser using this name.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: devpath
attributes.digest: Development Path
attributes.description: Allows you to choose a project-specific folder for development of AMXD based projects. When set, all device files for the project will be saved to and referenced from this location. When disabled, the project uses the global folder ~/Documents/Max 8/Max for Live Devices.

attributes.name: devpathtype
attributes.digest: Development Path Type
attributes.description: If enabled, allows you to specify the path type for the folder specified in the Development Path setting.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hideprojectwindow
attributes.digest: Hide Project Window After Opening
attributes.description: If enabled (and only if the Project contains patchers which are marked "Open on Project Load"), the Project window will not be visible after the Project opens.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: includepackages

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.digest: Max for Live Device is read only
attributes.description: If enabled, the exported Max for Live device will be read only.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: showdependencies
attributes.digest: Show Patcher Dependencies
attributes.description: If enabled, implicit dependencies are displayed in the Project window.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: sortmode
attributes.digest: Project Items Sort Order
attributes.description: If set to "Manual", project items can be arranged manually. If set to "Ascending", project items will automatically be arranged from A-Z. If set to "Descending", project items will automatically be arranged from Z-A.
